title: docs: `manifest-deps` still reads as live in ADR-0025 (L159, L267, L595–596, against its own §3.3), and plugin-distribution.md names tsup where `os plugin build` uses esbuild
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate ①: wrong sentences in governance and design prose, with named locations. This is the same family as #27685, the `manifest-deps` retirement leftovers. It came out of PR #27698 (#27685, os-dev report on #27685, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Filed without `domain:*`: `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface (Tier H), so triage sets the lane. The design-note half is `domain:devx`.
Business reason: an agent or developer reading ADR-0025 meets an example manifest that offers `bundled | manifest-deps`, an install step that runs `pnpm install` "for manifest-deps", and a consequence that promises an opt-in `manifest-deps` strategy for native addons. The ADR's own §3.3 says the strategy is RETIRED (Q6), and since #27679 the schema refuses `manifest-deps` by name. The design note sends a reader to `tsup`, while `os plugin build` bundles with esbuild.
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns. One PR. The ADR half needs a human approval (Tier H).
Dedupe: `manifest-deps` grepped over `docs/adr/` and `tsup` over `docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` at `origin/main`. Apart from #27685 / PR #27698, which leave these lines alone by their claim, no card names them.

## Measured (`origin/main`, after #27679; the design-note lines read at PR #27698's head `8dee70e6bb`)

1. `docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md`:
   - `:159`: `"packaging": "bundled",             // bundled | manifest-deps  (see §3.3)`;
   - `:267–268` (§3.5 step 5): "For manifest-deps, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` here.";
   - `:595–596` (consequences): "Bundled packaging excludes native addons by default (mitigated by the opt-in manifest-deps strategy in Phase 5).";
   - for contrast, `:187` already reads "manifest-deps — RETIRED (v2, maintainer decision Q6, 2026-10-28 …".
2. `docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` at `8dee70e6bb`:
   - `:113` (tree comment): "pre-built ESM bundle (tsup)";
   - `:164` (§5 step 1): "run `tsup` (externalize `@objectstack/*`)";
   - against `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/build.ts:11` "esbuild-bundle the entry to `dist/index.mjs`" and `:34` `import type { … } from 'esbuild'`.

## Wanted

- Align the three ADR passages with its own §3.3 and the schema, in place, as amendment-style edits, the way the ADR's v2 notes already do. Native addons: say what the platform does today; measure it from `build.ts`.
- Name esbuild in the design note.
- Do this after PR #27698 lands, which touches the same design-note file.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n 'manifest-deps' -- docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` hits only the retirement record (§3.3, the Q6 row and the v2 change notes).
- `git grep -n -w tsup -- docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` → 0.
